installation: isolated /tmp, ignored scripts, 22 packages; not a project dependency
scope: actual one-node interrupt/resume probe without model or tracing; not a PostgresSaver comparison or production runtime benchmark
decision: retain direct TypeScript controller and explicit PostgreSQL transactions for this bounded linear workflow
reason: Framework can checkpoint/interrupt, but restarted node still needs application idempotency/auth and RAM saver is not durable. No demonstrated additional capability needed by the current four-step workflow; a durable saver would still require our security boundaries.
limitations: No latency, local-model compatibility, general quality or superiority claim. Reconsider if durable graph branching becomes a measured need.
